title: Zainab e hazeene man khwahara khuda hafiz
body:
Zainb E Hazeen E Maan Khwahara Khuda Hafiz
Aye Be Gham Kharine Maan Khwahara Khuda Hafiz
1. Maan Ke Be Alamdaram, Be Moein O Beyaraam
Az Haayat E Be Zaaram, Khwahara Khuda....
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Mausam E Judayi Shud, Wadaye Khudayi Shud
Roz E Be Nawayi Shud, Khwahara Khuda....
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Baad E Qasim O Akber, Man Naa Daraam Aaye Khwaher
Meel E Zindagi Deegar, Khwahara Khuda....
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Kufa E Qarab Az Tu, Naal'ae Rabab Az Tu
Majlis E Shahrab Az Tu, Khwahara Khuda
